audit.why: 50.67% over 5037 games is a true even lane. Darius owns levels 1-5, Aatrox's swing is World Ender plus first item. Existing phase sides already say exactly that and match the mirror at audits/top/aatrox__darius.json.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] credits World Ender with a 'revive-window' and spikes[2]/late credit 'Eclipse/Goredrinker omnivamp'. Riot's World Ender text gives fear-on-minions, bonus AD, increased healing and move speed — no revive. Goredrinker no longer exists.
audit.why: The level-6 spike is real but its mechanism is wrong, and a player waiting to bait a revive that does not exist will mistime the execute.
audit.corrected: World Ender (120/100/80) amplifies his healing, adds AD and move speed and fears your minions; the sustain that beats your bleed at first item is Umbral Dash's on-damage healing, not an item that was removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never names a single Aatrox ability (packet defect), and full.dosFull[0] pairs the trigger 'E-pull when his E charges are down' with a description about his ultimate's drain — trigger and advice describe different abilities.
audit.why: Umbral Dash is 9/8/7/6/5 and heals him whenever he damages a champion; The Darkin Blade is 14/12/10/8/6; Infernal Chains is 20/18/16/14/12. Those numbers are what make 'wait, then pull' concrete, and none of them reach the page.
audit.corrected: Name Umbral Dash, The Darkin Blade and World Ender with their real cooldowns, and key the pull to Umbral Dash being spent rather than to a vague 'charges' reference.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is listed as a do but the reason given under dontsFull[1] is copied from the Apprehend/Ghost cooldown note.
audit.why: _missing/darius.json flags Aatrox as the archetypal needs-antiheal matchup (Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash, World Ender). Grievous Wounds timing is the whole extended-trade math and it deserves the real reason.
audit.corrected: Tie Grievous Wounds explicitly to World Ender's healing amplification on its 120s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.difficulty says 7.5/10 and breakdown.carry says 7.5/10, while diffRating is 5.5/10, carryRating is 6/10 and the Final Matchup Rating report line says 5.5/10 and 6/10.
audit.why: Three numbers on one page disagree; the reader cannot tell which is the matchup's real difficulty.
audit.corrected: Align the breakdown prose to 5.5/10 difficulty and 6/10 carry threat.

edits.before: With W and E online you win every extended trade: E-pull him into a Q outer-ring, Crippling Strike the reset, and let Hemorrhage stacks tick. Aatrox pre-6 has no way to out-sustain five Hemorrhage stacks.
edits.after: With W and E online you win every extended trade: Apprehend him into a Decimate outer-ring, Crippling Strike the reset, and let Hemorrhage tick. Umbral Dash heals him per hit, but pre-6 nothing survives five stacks.

edits.before: This is Aatrox's swing. His R gives him bonus AD, healing and a revive-window, so all-in fights that you'd win pre-6 now flip — he can eat your R and heal it back off your own minions.
edits.after: This is Aatrox's swing. World Ender, 120s at rank 1, gives bonus AD, amplified healing and move speed, so all-ins you'd win pre-6 flip — he heals your Hemorrhage chip straight back off the wave.

edits.before: Once Aatrox finishes Eclipse/Goredrinker his omnivamp on Q3 sweeps mean he sustains through your Hemorrhage bleed. Don't extend into full-combo Aatrox without your own ult up.
edits.after: Once his first item lands, Umbral Dash's on-damage healing behind The Darkin Blade sweeps out-sustains your Hemorrhage bleed. Don't extend into all three swings without Noxian Guillotine up.

edits.before: Aatrox scales harder into a teamfight profile with his knockups and healing; your value drops unless you snowballed the early lead into towers and a big Noxian Might bonus-AD state.
edits.after: Aatrox scales into a teamfight profile on World Ender's healing amp and The Darkin Blade's sweeps; your value drops unless you snowballed the early lead into towers and Hemorrhage-fed Noxian Might.

edits.before: You own levels 1-2: Q the outer ring on his approach and your base stats plus Hemorrhage bleed beat his weak early Q cadence. He has no dash pre-E-max, so he can't kite your E-pull yet.
edits.after: You own levels 1-2: land Decimate's outer ring on his approach and Hemorrhage bleed beats The Darkin Blade's 14s rank-1 cadence. Until he banks a point in Umbral Dash he cannot slip Apprehend.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are your kill window — W + E + 5-stack Hemorrhage is a full health bar of pressure he can't answer while his Q knockups are on cooldown. Force these all-ins hard before he hits 6.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are your kill window — Crippling Strike, Apprehend and 5-stack Hemorrhage are a health bar he cannot answer while The Darkin Blade is down. Force the all-in before World Ender comes online.

edits.before: After his ultimate and first item the trade math flips: Aatrox's R bonus-AD, revive and Eclipse omnivamp let him win the extended fights you used to dominate. Play for pick angles and don't 1v1 him with his cooldowns up.
edits.after: After his ultimate and first item the trade math flips: World Ender's bonus AD and healing amp, stacked on Umbral Dash's on-damage heal, win the extended fights you used to dominate. Never 1v1 him with World Ender up.

edits.before: You-favoured: 5-stack Hemorrhage all-ins overwhelm his cooldown-gated Q knockups.
edits.after: You-favoured: 5-stack Hemorrhage all-ins overwhelm The Darkin Blade on its 14s cooldown.

edits.before: Aatrox-favoured: his ult's bonus-AD, healing and revive plus Eclipse omnivamp out-sustain your bleed at first item.
edits.after: Aatrox-favoured: World Ender's bonus AD and healing amp plus Umbral Dash's on-damage heal out-sustain your bleed.

edits.before: Aatrox-favoured: he out-scales into knockup-and-heal teamfight value while your dueling edge fades.
edits.after: Aatrox-favoured: he out-scales into World Ender teamfight value while your duelling edge fades.

edits.before: Land the sweet-spot (edge) of all three Q casts to poke and heal
edits.after: Land the edge of all three Darkin Blade swings to poke and heal

edits.before: Reach 6 and use R's revive to bait your R execute
edits.after: Reach 6 and use World Ender to out-heal your bleed

edits.before: Drag fights past first item so Eclipse omnivamp out-sustains your bleed
edits.after: Drag fights past first item so Umbral Dash's heal out-sustains your bleed

edits.before: Bait his Q outer-ring, step in during the recovery, then E-pull for a guaranteed Q inner-hit + W
edits.after: Bait a Darkin Blade swing, step in on the recovery, then Apprehend for a guaranteed inner Decimate + W

edits.before: Stack Hemorrhage to 5 before he can Q3-heal, then reset the trade
edits.after: Stack Hemorrhage to 5 before Umbral Dash heals it off, then reset

edits.before: E-pull when his E charges are down
edits.after: Apprehend once Umbral Dash is spent

edits.before: His drain ramps in long fights. Burst him before/while it’s down. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Umbral Dash is 9s at rank 1 and heals him as he damages you. Pull the moment he spends it — that is your trade window.

edits.before: Your committal tool is the lane — burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: World Ender amps his healing on a 120s cooldown — bring Grievous Wounds before you contest it.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track World Ender and how disciplined your trade windows are.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track World Ender's 120s cooldown and your trade discipline.

edits.before: Carry threat: 7.5/10. If Aatrox gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and playing with your jungler.
edits.after: Carry threat: 6/10. If Aatrox gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and playing with your jungler.
